response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and open-source development experience with a focus on modern web technologies, but his background lacks depth in C++ for industrial automation, secure development lifecycle (SDL), and industrial cybersecurity standards like IEC 62443. His profile shows adaptability and leadership, but the role's core requirements are not fully met.
strengths: Extensive experience in full-stack development, including modern architectures and event-driven systems.
Strong open-source contributions and leadership in technical communities (workshops, talks, mentoring).
Diverse technical background with exposure to low-latency systems, multi-threading, and distributed architectures.
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience, especially in industrial automation or high-performance on-premises/cloud systems.
No explicit mention of secure development lifecycle (SDL) or industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443).
Primary expertise lies in web/mobile technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, React), which are not core to this role.
